notes: Google Antigravity (VS Code AI fork) – Google OAuth via Authorization Code + PKCE. client_id: 1071006060591-tmhssin2h21lcre235vtolojh4g403ep.apps.googleusercontent.com. Token: ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json. Antigravity's local interface is a gRPC language server (127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port>/exa.language_server_pb.LanguageServerService/…) – faigate bypasses it and calls the Google Generative Language API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai) directly with the OAuth token. Auth: faigate-auth google-antigravity  or sign in to Antigravity IDE.
